mapper.select: SELECT b.cytoband_id AS band_id, COUNT(DISTINCT dbm.disease_id) AS disease_count FROM cytoband b JOIN chromosome c ON c.chromosome_id = b.chromosome_id LEFT JOIN disease_band_map dbm ON dbm.cytoband_id = b.cytoband_id WHERE c.chr_name = #{chromosome} GROUP BY b.cytoband_id ORDER BY b.start_bp
